processing.summaries: Assistant-written paraphrases of public listings and issue conversations.
processing.topic_labels: Simple keyword heuristics over listing titles and paraphrases; multi-label and not demand measurements.
processing.duplicates: All source records are retained. Repeated titles and repository fields are flagged for review.
processing.external_claims: Runtime behavior, deployments, market demand, and awards were not independently established by this collection.
processing.data_minimization: No full website assets, browser profiles, credentials, email addresses, or full post bodies are included.

limits: Dashboard fetch required sign-in; collection used documented anonymous public APIs.
The board is not a verified historical hackathon-winner database.
Activity is an explicit 100-event sample, not an exhausted archive or a transcript of community chats.
Private Telegram, Discord, and authenticated conversations were not accessed.
Activity and catalog requests with limit=100 returned HTTP 400 despite the downloaded schema; default page sizes worked.
The connected browser reported 136 rows but returned zero extracted entries; it is not the source of the dataset.

scraper_review.finding: Arc House-specific hosts, GraphQL operations, session attachment, and source projections. Original scraper and archive were left untouched.
scraper_review.chosen_method: Documented public JSON reads with terminal-pagination and record-count verification.
